delete.summary: Cancel a pending or failed replication plan
delete.description:
Stops a pending or failed replication plan from being claimed again. A
running plan cannot be cancelled because the worker owns it mid-flight;
such a request fails with 409. Completed and already-cancelled plans are
also not cancellable. The plan record is retained for audit.

resourcePrefix.description: Optional canonical resource prefix. Empty or omitted grants repository-wide access.

enabled.description: Whether scheduled and manual retention execution is enabled.

keepDays.description: Days to retain artifacts or versions before cleanup eligibility.

snapshotKeepDays.description: Days to retain Maven SNAPSHOT versions. Defaults to keepDays when omitted.

minimumVersions.description: Minimum newest versions protected per Maven module, OCI image, or Conan reference. Raw paths do not use version-count rules.

maximumVersions.description: Maximum versions retained per Maven module, OCI image, or Conan reference. Zero disables the count cap; Raw paths do not use it.

coordinatePatterns.description: Optional RE2 regular expressions selecting coordinates eligible for cleanup.

protectedPatterns.description: RE2 regular expressions protecting matching coordinates from cleanup.

enabled.description: Enforce for promotions into this repository.

primaryBytes.description: Cached primary artifact bytes when the repository exposes cache projections.

sidecarBytes.description: Cached metadata and checksum sidecar bytes.

expiredObjectCount.description: Expired cache entries eligible for reclamation.

reclaimableBytes.description: Expired cached bytes eligible for reclamation.

expiresAt.description: Time after which the key can no longer authenticate.
Optional expiry. Defaults to 90 days and cannot exceed 365 days.

CreatePublishSession.description: Maven-only management publish session. Raw Hosted writes use PUT /raw/{repository}/{path}; OCI Hosted writes use Registry V2 upload and manifest routes.

CommitMavenCoordinate.description: Expected names detect incomplete upload only. Digest, size, checksum, metadata, object keys, and visibility are derived and controlled by the Gateway.

version.description: Exact package version when the format exposes one independently from the coordinate.

versionCount.description: Number of versions represented by a package-level browse result.

buildNumber.description: Snapshot build number; zero for release coordinates.

publisher.description: Publisher actor when the format records it.
Publisher actor of the most recent committed publish session for this coordinate. Empty when no publish session was recorded (for example replicated or pre-session artifacts).

buildNumber.description: Snapshot build number. Zero for release coordinates; one or greater for each published build of a SNAPSHOT coordinate.

publisher.description: Publisher actor of the most recent committed publish session for this reference. Empty when no publish session was recorded (for example replicated or pre-session artifacts).

authorizationSource.description: Optional bounded authorization decision source. Current values include repository_grants, legacy_static, legacy_protocol, and administrator; consumers must accept future bounded values.

authorizationReason.description: Optional bounded authorization decision reason. Current values include scope_not_granted and grant_lookup_failed; consumers must accept future bounded values.

enabled.description: Permits unauthenticated protocol reads only when the Repository or Group policy also allows them.

matchKind.description: Whether this result matched a coordinate prefix or an exact digest.

searchedRepositories.description: Number of readable active repositories considered by this query.

EgressProxy.description: Per-Proxy-Repository egress network proxy configuration. Only meaningful when the repository type is proxy. `password` is accepted on write (plaintext over TLS) and stored AES-256-GCM encrypted; responses never return it and carry `credentialsConfigured` instead.

mode.description: direct bypasses any proxy (keeping private-address protection); environment follows process HTTP(S)_PROXY/NO_PROXY; custom uses the per-repository proxy below.

protocol.description: Custom proxy protocol. http uses CONNECT; socks5 supports optional remote DNS.

host.description: Custom proxy hostname or IP, without scheme or credentials.

password.description: Optional proxy authentication password. Write-only; stored encrypted. Omit on update to keep stored credentials.

clearCredentials.description: When true on update, removes any stored proxy credentials.

remoteDns.description: socks5 only. When true the proxy resolves the upstream hostname (socks5h); when false the gateway resolves locally and keeps the private-address check.

noProxy.description: Upstream host suffixes or CIDR ranges that bypass the custom proxy and connect directly. Matched against the upstream host, never the proxy host.

credentialsConfigured.description: True when encrypted proxy credentials are stored.

repositoryId.description: Required for repository-retention and omitted for audit-retention.

nextRunAt.description: Defaults to one interval after creation.

UpdateRepository.description: Editable repository management policy and proxy configuration. Hosted repositories only accept anonymousRead updates; name, format, and type are immutable after creation.

endpoint.description: Upstream base URL (https). Required for proxy repositories.

allowedHosts.description: Hosts the proxy may egress to. Required for raw, conan, and npm proxies. npm tarball redirects are limited to this list.

anonymousRead.description: Anonymous read policy. Defaults to false and permits unauthenticated protocol GET/HEAD where effective policy allows it.

EgressProxyTestResult.description: Ephemeral result of an egress proxy connection test. Nothing is persisted.

proxyHost.description: Custom proxy host (no credentials) when mode is custom.

upstreamStatus.description: HTTP status returned by the upstream probe, when reached.

error.description: Sanitized failure reason when reachable is false.

resource.description: Concrete canonical resource evaluated for prefix-scoped grants; empty means repository-wide access.

simulated.description: True when an administrator supplied an actor instead of evaluating the authenticated caller.

conan.description: Conan 2 supports Group/Proxy read-through and native Hosted resolution under the existing /conan/v2 route family. Hosted publication uses the repository management publish-session contract; lifecycle operations use the native Hosted revision routes, while indexed reference browse/search is exposed through the versioned management API.
